column1: # Test targets whose count CI asserts, so a suite that empties itself is caught.
# Arming the skip gates makes an *unrun* test fail; it cannot catch a target that
# cargo omits entirely (required-features) or a file whose #[test]s were deleted.
# This manifest is that backstop: scripts/test-count-gate.sh runs each target and
# fails when fewer than min_passed tests pass, or when no test binary ran at all.
# Run it where the dependencies exist. The first block needs a Postgres
# (CATALYRST_TEST_PG, or the per-crate variable); catalyrst-fed's nats_live also
# needs FED_NATS_URL. The second block needs nothing at all, so a machine with no
# services can still run that half by naming those crates on the command line.
# min_passed is the count observed when the row was added. Adding tests is free.
# Raise this floor by adding rows or raising a number, never by lowering one: a
# target that stops meeting its floor is the gate working, not the gate to edit.
# No external dependency below this line.
